case_title: Nagji Odha Vji Kumbhar & Anr. v. State of Gujarat
aggravating_circumstances: Multiple injuries on vital parts, use of weapons
neutral_facts: The incident occurred at night in a village when the accused, who were armed with weapons, attacked two deceased individuals and two injured witnesses. The accused were involved in a confrontation, and the deceased were not armed. The prosecution presented evidence including statements from injured witnesses, medical reports detailing the injuries sustained by both the deceased and the accused, and a post-mortem report confirming stab wounds on the deceased. The accused claimed they were acting in self-defense, but the court found no evidence to support this claim. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 IPC for causing the deaths of the deceased.
